name: inphyni_lapalma
label: INPHYNI large-area time-tag detector for La Palma (2027)
sources: R. Kaiser (INPHYNI), email to P. Nugent 2026-11-09 ('Targets La Palma'): 1 nm filter at 417 nm (or 431 nm), 2 channels (two polarizations) per telescope, 20 % detection efficiency (large-area detectors, no fibre coupling), 35 ps rms jitter including TDC, detector and synchronization; ready for early 2027
notes: jitter_fwhm_ps 82.4 = 2.355 x 35 ps rms (Gaussian), the whole chain. One entry per polarization channel: the backends use polarization_mode pbs (two detectors per telescope, half the flux and full contrast each, added in quadrature).
Dead time, dark rate and the 10 Mcps ceiling are not supplied: ASSUMED (the Calern SNSPD values).
